parameters.query:
WITH months AS (
	SELECT generate_series(
		date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '1 month',
		date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
		interval '1 month'
	)::date AS month
),
src AS (
	SELECT date_trunc('month', l.logged_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS month, l.*
	FROM public.site_request_log l
	WHERE l.logged_at >= (SELECT min(month) FROM months)
	  AND l.endpoint <> 'test_zzz'
	  AND coalesce(l.source, '') NOT LIKE 'test_zzz%'
	  AND coalesce(l.slug, '') NOT LIKE 'test_zzz%'
	  AND coalesce(l.q, '') NOT LIKE 'test_zzz%'
),
agg AS (
	SELECT month, 'endpoint_status' AS metric, endpoint, status AS key, count(*) AS count,
	       NULL::int AS p50_ms, NULL::int AS p95_ms
	FROM src GROUP BY month, endpoint, status
	UNION ALL
	SELECT month, 'reason', endpoint, coalesce(reason, ''), count(*), NULL, NULL
	FROM src GROUP BY month, endpoint, reason
	UNION ALL
	SELECT month, 'auth', endpoint, coalesce(auth, ''), count(*), NULL, NULL
	FROM src GROUP BY month, endpoint, auth
	UNION ALL
	SELECT month, 'top_query', endpoint, key, count, NULL, NULL FROM (
		SELECT month, endpoint, lower(q) AS key, count(*) AS count,
		       row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY month, endpoint ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS rn
		FROM src WHERE q IS NOT NULL AND q <> '' GROUP BY month, endpoint, lower(q)
	) t WHERE rn <= 50
	UNION ALL
	SELECT month, 'zero_result_query', endpoint, key, count, NULL, NULL FROM (
		SELECT month, endpoint, lower(q) AS key, count(*) AS count,
		       row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY month, endpoint ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS rn
		FROM src WHERE status = 'empty' AND q IS NOT NULL AND q <> '' GROUP BY month, endpoint, lower(q)
	) t WHERE rn <= 200
	UNION ALL
	SELECT month, 'not_found_slug', endpoint, key, count, NULL, NULL FROM (
		SELECT month, endpoint, slug AS key, count(*) AS count,
		       row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY month, endpoint ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS rn
		FROM src
		WHERE slug IS NOT NULL AND slug <> ''
		  AND (status = 'not-found' OR (endpoint = 'v3/lookup' AND status = 'error'))
		GROUP BY month, endpoint, slug
	) t WHERE rn <= 200
	UNION ALL
	SELECT month, 'duration', endpoint, '', count(duration_ms),
	       percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::int,
	       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::int
	FROM src WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month, endpoint
)
INSERT INTO public.site_request_monthly AS m
	(month, metric, endpoint, key, count, p50_ms, p95_ms, computed_at)
SELECT month, metric, endpoint, key, count, p50_ms, p95_ms, now() FROM agg
ON CONFLICT (month, metric, endpoint, key) DO UPDATE
	SET count = EXCLUDED.count, p50_ms = EXCLUDED.p50_ms, p95_ms = EXCLUDED.p95_ms, computed_at = now()

INSERT INTO public.site_request_monthly AS m
	(month, metric, endpoint, key, raw_row_count, raw_table_bytes, new_rows, computed_at)
SELECT date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, 'growth', '', '',
       (SELECT count(*) FROM public.site_request_log),
       pg_total_relation_size('public.site_request_log'),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM public.site_request_log
         WHERE logged_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
       now()
ON CONFLICT (month, metric, endpoint, key) DO UPDATE
	SET raw_row_count = EXCLUDED.raw_row_count, raw_table_bytes = EXCLUDED.raw_table_bytes,
	    new_rows = EXCLUDED.new_rows, computed_at = now()
